profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Computer Software Engineering
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing, developing, and modernizing Java-based microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native enterprise systems. Strong background in financial services, banking, and large-scale distributed platforms. Proven ability to lead teams, modernize legacy systems, and deliver scalable, maintainable solutions within regulated environments.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
In charge of project Management as well as development and maintenance for different applications being developed for external clients.
Succesfully developed and deployed a real state app for a client from begining to end, using react native as a base as well as JAVA for apis needed.
Provided improvements and maintenance to Tacomabeast's e-commerce website. improving the way data is handled, and how payments and orders are processed.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · React Native · SQL · Firebase · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team in developing Java APIs with Spring and Springboot for banking at Capco.
• Managed project timelines and ensured successful delivery as team leader for 2 quarters.
• Designed batch processes to streamline data unification, enhancing efficiency and accuracy.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and updated visuals for the homebanking app at Citibank, enhancing user experience.
• Implemented new features and functionalities to improve app performance.
• Contributed to the development of Fraud department API using Spring Java and JavaScript for the frontend.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Provided L3 support for a short term project on the 7eleven logistics platform using NodeJs and javascript.
• Collaborated with overseas team via Jira to ensure seamless support and issue resolution.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed iOS and Android apps for clients like Walmart and TacomaBeast using Swift and Java.
• Implemented backend and API development in Java, utilizing technologies like Spring Boot and Hibernate.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions for various clients.
• Utilized technologies such as Swift, Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create innovative solutions.

positions.title: Java and C# aplication developer
positions.locationName: Buenos Aires, Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina
positions.description:
• Developed Java and C# applications using technologies like Hibernate, Spring, and SQL for IBM's software factory.
• Implemented various architectures like MVC, MVVM, and MVP to enhance software performance.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions for IBM, contributing to the company's success.

positions.title: RPA developer
positions.description:
• Developed custom bots using Java, C#, Blue Prism, and other RPA tools for clients like YPF and ICBC bank.
• Collaborated with internal teams to automate processes, resulting in increased efficiency and cost savings.
• Implemented SQL queries to optimize bot performance and data processing for various projects.
